implementation_and_test_controls: implement the broker, detached supervisor, exclusive recovery contract, and terminal evidence path without reading a real credential
preserve both prior partials, their staging paths, attempts, receipts, and reconciliations byte-for-byte
prove with synthetic credentials and a local fixture that the token is absent from process command lines, environment, files, logs, events, and repository changes
prove with a synthetic forced broker-console termination that the detached supervisor remains alive and reaches a terminal success or failure record
prove that every ordinary child exit produces a terminal record and that absence of a worker is independently reconcilable from heartbeat and process-state evidence
prove exclusive staging, byte-zero requests without Range, exact length and checksum failure preservation, redirect refusal, path containment, and atomic no-replace promotion
publish the exact implementation and synthetic tests, verify the remote commit, and require a successful public CI run before activating a real attempt
perform a final deterministic no-payload preflight that rehashes both retained partials and confirms the destination remains absent
real_attempt_preconditions: the exact proposal and review bundle have a completed approving owner response that is locked and reconciled
the exact implementation commit has passed the public-CI publication gate
the current normalized CDSE legal section, structured modification date, OData documentation, token documentation, and Sentinel Legal Notice match their accepted controls
the provider UUID, product name, online state, catalog length, and provider checksums match the accepted source identity
both retained partials match their recorded lengths and SHA-256 values
the final destination remains absent and the recovery-002 staging namespace is new and exclusive
a fresh owner-controlled access token is supplied only through the tested in-memory broker channel
transfer_controls: request the complete exact product from byte zero without Range or resume semantics
stream only to the new exclusive recovery-002 staging path while computing local SHA-256 and provider MD5
write nonsecret started and periodic heartbeat evidence outside Git so interruption state remains inspectable
require exact catalog length and provider MD5 before promotion
promote with atomic no-replace semantics and rehash the promoted file
run the existing offline ZIP and SAFE container verification without extraction
post_success_release: reconcile M1-SRC-004 as satisfied only through the separately approved successful recovery-002 identity
resume only M1-SRC-005, M1-SRC-006, M1-SRC-008, and M1-SRC-010 under the original eight-product approval
run one product at a time and stop with preserved evidence on any later transfer or verification failure
proposed_recovery.failure_policy: Any recovery-002 failure is terminal for that identity, preserves all prior and new evidence, stops all further Sentinel transfer, and requires another exact human review; no automatic retry is authorized.

approval_would_authorize: implement and validate only the exact secret-safe detached-worker recovery design and synthetic interruption tests described here
publish and independently verify the exact implementation and public-CI gate before any real transfer
perform at most one fresh full M1-SRC-004 recovery-002 transfer from byte zero through a new exclusive staging path
verify and promote only that exact product if every identity, rights, secret-custody, length, checksum, path, interruption, and container control passes
after a passing recovery, continue only the four still-unattempted products under the original eight-product approval
approval_would_not_authorize: resume, delete, truncate, rename, overwrite, or otherwise modify either retained partial or any prior event or receipt
reuse either prior staging path, hide either failure, or reinterpret either partial as an admissible product
place a token in a command line, environment variable, file, repository record, log, event, or heartbeat
run more than one recovery-002 attempt or automatically retry any failure
change the provider UUID, product name, observation time, role, sensor route, destination, or source manifest
accept terms, create, recover, or modify an account, change MFA, incur cost, or disclose credentials
acquire substitute imagery, additional products, or precise orbit files
perform radar terrain correction, pixel admission, change mapping, attribution, or scientific publication
limitations: The cause of the recovery-001 process termination is unknown; this design addresses console ownership and evidence durability but does not claim to eliminate every possible external process termination.
The detached-worker design is proposed, not yet implemented or validated; approval would release its bounded implementation and synthetic tests before any real transfer.
A fresh transfer may fail again and has no automatic second attempt.
Container success would not establish raster readability, AOI coverage, usable pixels, registration, or scientific change.
This proposal creates no authority until the exact review bundle is approved, locked, and reconciled.
